verified_major_claims.claim: RA 9266 IRR defines foreign architect as not Filipino, not registered/licensed in the Philippines, but duly registered/licensed in the home country.
verified_major_claims.evidence_excerpt: not a Filipino citizen ... duly registered and licensed in his/her home country.

verified_major_claims.claim: RA 9266 IRR defines Filipino counterpart as the local Philippine architect/entity that must work in association with the foreign architect/entity on Philippine soil.
verified_major_claims.evidence_excerpt: must work in association with a foreign architect ... on a project on Philippine soil.

verified_major_claims.claim: Section 38 requires foreign nationals to secure a special/temporary permit from the Board, subject to Commission approval, before assuming covered duties.
verified_major_claims.evidence_excerpt: before assuming ... secure a special/temporary permit from the Board subject to approval of the Commission.

verified_major_claims.claim: Appearance of a foreign person/firm name with architect/design consultant titles on architectural plans, specifications, construction documents, permits, advertisements, or billboards can be deemed practice.
verified_major_claims.evidence_excerpt: whose name or company name ... appears on architectural plans ... shall be deemed practicing architecture.

verified_major_claims.claim: Section 36 makes it unlawful for an unregistered person to collect fees for architectural services except as employee representative of a Registered Architect.
verified_major_claims.evidence_excerpt: unlawful for any unregistered person to collect a fee ... except as an employee.

verified_major_claims.claim: Temporary/Special Permit is for one project; another project requires separate application and fees.
verified_major_claims.evidence_excerpt: issued to a foreign architect for one (1) project alone.

verified_major_claims.claim: Foreign architect with a temporary/special permit cannot act as Architect-of-record; signing/sealing responsibility is reserved to the Filipino counterpart.
verified_major_claims.evidence_excerpt: cannot act as the Architect-of-record ... reserved solely for the Filipino counterpart.

verified_major_claims.claim: Section 27 reciprocity requires the foreign country to admit Filipino citizens to the same profession without restriction or on strict and absolute equality after examination.
verified_major_claims.evidence_excerpt: admits citizens of the Philippines ... without restriction ... strict and absolute equality.
